name: Emissary of Loot
subtitle: it's your money. you paid for it.
rules: When a card that provides at least [G] enters play under your control, you may put a token on this card. -- DELIVER -- COST – Pay 1. Remove a token from this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 2 life. -- SHORTCUT -- COST – Pay 1. Remove a token from this card. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains COVERT.

name: Essence of Greed
subtitle: take one down, pass it around
rules: Choose one of the following as this card's rules text: -- OPTION 1 -- Draw a card. -- OPTION 2 -- EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 2 life. -- OPTION 3 -- Your faction gains 4 influence.

name: Executive Order #6370u7
subtitle: by yon decree, thou shalt not interrupt the time of pooping
rules: At the start of an opponent's turn you may pay 2 and pick a character. If you do, deplete that character and this turn, it cannot be restored by its controller's faction's RESTORE RULE.
flavor: With Executive Order #6370u7, Padamose expelled the Mau from Marduun, clearing the way for a more sinister cult to form in their stead.

name: Exploitation
rules: This card provides – [G][G] -- When this card enters play, your faction loses 1 influence.
notes: Resource card, printed rotated (landscape). Card prints the PROVIDES line first, then the enters-play sentence; catalog lists them in the opposite order. Same effects.

name: Extravagant Contusion
subtitle: brained with a bling brick
rules: EXTRA COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X. Pick a character with numeric cost X or less. -- Destroy the character.
flavor: It's the things we love most that destroy us.

name: Fiscal Intercessor
subtitle: blessed be the moolah
rules: PLEAD -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – If damage is inflicted to the character this turn, reduce the amount by 1.
flavor: "May this moolah begat more moolah, and may that moolah also be ours. Let us give thanks for all that we have and all we shall take, and deliver our moolah from the taking of others."

name: Flabbergasting Philosopher
subtitle: what if there were no hypothetical questions?
rules: TACTICAL -- When this card enters play, your faction gains 4 influence. -- FLIP UP – 4 [G][G]

name: Foolhardy Desperado
subtitle: i don't think he's coming back
rules: COVERT -- When this card inflicts battle damage, your faction loses 2 influence.
flavor: "I hope no one minds but I have no intention of facing this sober."

name: Fountain Diver
subtitle: you see a fountain, i see an opportunity
rules: RECUR – [G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 1. Remove this card from the game. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 3 life.
flavor: Wishes do come true, especially when they aren't yours.

name: Framptle Tromwibbler, Lord of Bling
subtitle: peace is good for business
rules: UNIQUE FRAMPTLE -- Characters cannot attack or be restored. -- At the start of your turn, put a token on this card. -- When this card has at least 2 tokens on it, destroy it.
flavor: War is also good for business.
notes: Footer also reads 'original Open R&D concept by Lioge' (bottom-left, below artist).

name: Frisky Fortunehunter
subtitle: pirate in training
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 2 influence. -- When this card leaves play, your faction gains 4 influence.
flavor: "Argh matey! Jump off the plank! Heeheehehe!"

name: Gideon's Legacy
subtitle: terror and power runs in their blood
rules: SEEK -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- HIDE -- COST – Pick a player. Pick a card in that player's discard pile. X is its numeric cost. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Shuffle the card into its owner's deck. Each other player's faction gains X influence.

name: Grandiose Resurrector
subtitle: who dares disturb my slumb- ooh, is that catnip?
rules: RECUR – [G][G] -- COST – Use this only while this card is in your discard pile. Pay 5. Remove this card from the game. Pick up to 4 characters in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the characters into your hand.

name: Gus VanBaymaven
subtitle: all this is mine now
rules: UNIQUE GUS -- ALL YOUR BAYS ARE BELONG TO GUS -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Pick a location. -- EFFECT – Take control of the location. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G][G][G]

name: Hidden Ruins
subtitle: covered by the desert sands
rules: EXTRA COST – Reveal a face-down location you control. -- You may deploy the location. Draw a card. -- While this card is in your discard pile, when a card that provides at least [G] enters play under your control, you may pay 2. If you do, put this card into play under your control as a face-down resource. -- FLIP UP – 1 [G]

name: High Court of Demands
subtitle: but the people want us to be rich
rules: When this card enters play, draw a card. -- Your opponents cannot attack your faction.
flavor: "For the last time, Senator Winterbottom, your proposed self-enrichment bill is denied!"

name: Hungry-Hungry Idol
subtitle: feed the idol as fast as you can! but be careful...
rules: FEED -- COST – Pay 1. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 1 life. Your faction loses 1 influence.
flavor: "I win!"

name: Imperial Palace
subtitle: it's alright i guess
rules: At the end of your turn you may pay 1. If you do, pick a character you control and put it into the void. At the start of your next turn put the voided character into play under your control.
flavor: It's where I keep my stuff.

name: Inconvenient Roadblock
subtitle: i think it's like, cultural or something
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only during a battle. -- Reduce all battle damage inflicted during this battle to 0. Draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 1 [G]
flavor: "Far be it from me to criticize your stupid civilization with its dumb customs."

name: Karmic Cake
subtitle: frosted with righteousness
rules: Search your deck for a resource and reveal it. Put it into your hand. -- RECUR – [G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a staple resource and reveal it. Put it into your hand.
flavor: Filled with delicious cream filling.

name: Lodge Dock Florist
subtitle: "hoe-cake, murder."
rules: UNIQUE LODGE DOCK FLORIST -- All characters gain the rules text "At the start of your turn, you may pay 1. If you don't, destroy this card."
flavor: Mural: Yonder nor sorghum stenches shut ladle gulls stopper torque wet strainers.
artist: Jennyson Rosero and Buddy Jiang of Imaginary Friends Studios

name: Marduun Baitings and Loan
subtitle: no credit, no collateral, no problem
rules: UNIQUE MARDUUN BAITINGS AND LOAN -- [G][G][G] – At the start of your turn, your faction gains 2 influence. -- [G][G][G][G][G] – At the start of your turn, draw a card. Discard a card. -- [G][G][G][G][G][G][G] – At the start of your turn, draw a card.
flavor: Just sign here where it says we get to turn your corpse into a mindless zombie when you die.

name: Mau Caravan
subtitle: the gilded promenade
rules: At the start of your turn, you may destroy this card. If you do, search your deck for a location, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
flavor:
"In its last days, the Marmothoan Empire became deeply indebted to mixed-blood relatives of the Emperor - the Mau. Enraged and without suitable recourse, Padamose declared all debts to 'housecats' absolved, thereby forcing their immediate flee across the desert. Their destination? A small mining town on the coast called Clockman..."
— Marduun, a Forgotten History
notes: Flavor attribution is printed inline after the closing quote (" - Marduun, a Forgotten History).

name: Melty Cheese
subtitle: sooo...tasty...
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 2 life and cannot attack. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G] and your faction gains 4 influence.
flavor: Sooo...bloated...
notes: Item prints attach modifiers +0 STR / +0 SPD / +2 LIFE in the corner badges (recorded as 0/0/2); these are modifiers, not base stats.

name: Miraculous Regeneration
subtitle: remember when you said you could sleep when you're dead?
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick 2 characters in your discard pile. -- Put 1 of the characters into play under your control as a face-down resource. Put the other character into your hand.
flavor: You were wrong.

name: Montgomery Blatherscythe
subtitle: every corpse has its price
rules: UNIQUE MONTGOMERY -- RESURRECT -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. Pick a character in your discard pile with numeric cost 2 or less. -- EFFECT – Put the character into play under your control.
flavor: "Oh, who's a gweedy wittle cadaver? Who wants a shiny?"

name: Mutineer's Hiatus
subtitle: a lovely view and all the seagulls you can eat
rules: EXTRA COST – Destroy a character you own. -- Draw 2 cards. -- RECUR – [G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. Pick a character you own. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character. Draw a card.

name: Overzealous Excavation
subtitle: those ruins were only getting in the way
rules: Put the top 8 cards of your deck into your discard pile. Draw a card. -- RECUR – [G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 4. Remove this card from the game. Pick a card in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the card into play under your control as a face-down resource.

name: Pilgrimage Auditor
subtitle: oh, you want to rest at that shrine over there?
rules: IMPEDE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Deplete the character.
flavor: "I'm sorry, but I'll have to deduct points for that."

name: Portly Tradesmau
subtitle: you seem familiar. have i cheated you before?
rules: When this card blocks, draw X cards, where X is the number of characters in the attacking party.
flavor: If by "junk" you mean "priceless artifacts" then I agree.

name: Prehensile Pirate
subtitle: it's like a long, furry finger
rules: EXTRA COST – Remove 4 cards in your discard pile from the game.
flavor: Another tragic loss that could have been prevented by Dentu-Grip.

name: Property Condemner
subtitle: haunted? it's my lucky day!
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick a location. If you do, destroy that location. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G][G]
flavor: We thought the ghosts were sort of fun, but the priest kicked us out anyway. Something about the church taking care of it....

name: Prophetic Assistant
subtitle: indispensable purveyor of divination
rules: At the end of your turn, you may reveal the top card of your deck. If you do and it is a staple resource, put it into your hand.

name: Prostitution Lobbyist
subtitle: show some respect, it's the oldest profession
rules: FLIP UP – 0 [G]
flavor: Perhaps I could be persuaded to support your measure... provided your measure supports what's in my pants.

name: Purifying Priest
subtitle: looks haunted to me. we'll just have to burn it.
rules: BANISH -- COST – Pick a location. -- EFFECT – The next 1 damage that would be inflicted to your faction this turn is inflicted to the location instead.
flavor: "...and build a new church on the land. You know, to purify it. We'll be accepting donations in the fall."

name: Slick Orator
subtitle: i don't do nuance
rules: RECUR – [G][G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: "As you know, these are open forums, you're able to come and listen to what I have to say."

name: Subordinate Demotivation
subtitle: go on... lick the toe!
rules: Destroy the character an opponent controls with the lowest numeric cost. If there is a tie, you decide which character is destroyed.
flavor: "You have to *earn* the right to mop my floor."
notes: Asterisks around 'earn' are printed literally on the card.

name: Temple Guardian
subtitle: blessed defender of sacred things
rules: DEFLECT -- COST – Pay 3. Deplete this card. Pick an attacking character. -- EFFECT – Remove the character from the battle.
flavor: I thought "arrow offering" day was next week...

name: The Brotherhood of the Mau
subtitle: they run the show
rules: COVERT -- This card enters play with 7 tokens on it. -- While this card has a token on it, it cannot attack. -- At the start of each turn, you may pay X. If you do, remove X tokens from this card and pick another character. That character gains X life this turn.
flavor: Extorting empires since before it was cool.

name: The Currency Bazaar
subtitle: even honesty is a financial speculation
rules: TRADE -- COST – Pay 1. Discard a resource. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a staple resource and reveal it. Put it into your hand. -- RECUR – [G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 3. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card named "The Currency Bazaar" and reveal it. Put it into your hand.

name: The Poshernacle
subtitle: the perfect place to pause a pilgrimage
rules: UNIQUE POSHERNACLE -- At the start of your turn, you may use an ability. -- At the start of your turn, you may draw a card. -- At the start of your turn, your faction gains 1 influence.
flavor: A large portable tent used for prayer, worship, and kicking back by the pool.
notes: Footer also reads 'original Open R&D game mechanic by kallisti' (bottom-left, below artist).

name: Theocratic Senate of Marduun
subtitle: we cannot speak for god
rules: UNIQUE THEOCRATIC SENATE OF MARDUUN -- Your opponents cannot attack your faction. -- When a character inflicts damage to this card, inflict the same amount of damage to the character.
flavor: We just do the paperwork and take his bribes.

name: Tiny Shiny
subtitle: i want it! i want it!
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- Reduce the next damage inflicted to the character this turn by 2. Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile.

name: Treasure Brokerage
subtitle: thank god for "buffet pants"
rules: When a character enters play under your control, you may pay 1. If you do, search your deck for a staple resource and reveal it. Put it into your hand.

name: Undead Sword
subtitle: bravery enslaved
rules: UNIQUE GIADA -- This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- HIDE AMONG THE CORPSES -- COST – Remove a token from this card. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains COVERT.
flavor: In death, nobility. In undeath, despair.
notes: Type line is printed 'nercomorph' (typo for necromorph); catalog has 'necromorph'.
